description:
Get recent actively exploited security alerts from the free CISA KEV catalog in plain English.

    Args:
        limit: Number of alerts to return (1 to 15, default 5).
        consumer_only: If True, focuses on everyday devices & browsers (Apple, Google, Microsoft, etc.).
        keyword: Optional product or vendor filter (max 100 chars, e.g. 'Chrome', 'iPhone').
name: get_latest_alerts
